howItWorks.heading: From Idea to Launch in Four Focused Sprints
howItWorks.body: Our battle-tested process removes the guesswork. Every engagement follows the same disciplined rhythm — transparent, iterative, and relentlessly focused on outcomes.

how-it-works.title: Discovery & Strategy
how-it-works.description: We spend the first week deep-diving into your business model, user personas, and technical landscape. You leave with a detailed product spec, AI opportunity map, and project roadmap.

how-it-works.title: Design & Prototyping
how-it-works.description: Our designers produce high-fidelity Figma prototypes and interactive demos in under two weeks. You validate the experience before a single line of production code is written.

how-it-works.title: Agile Development
how-it-works.description: Engineering squads work in two-week sprints with daily standups, live staging environments, and weekly demos. You always know exactly where your product stands.

how-it-works.title: Launch & Scale
how-it-works.description: We handle deployment, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and post-launch optimization. Once live, our growth team identifies the next AI-powered feature to keep you ahead.

caseStudies.heading: Work That Speaks for Itself
caseStudies.body: A selection of recent projects where we turned complex challenges into elegant, AI-driven solutions.

case-studies.title: NovaMed
case-studies.subtitle: AI Clinical Decision Support
case-studies.description: Built a HIPAA-compliant LLM-powered assistant for a US telehealth platform that surfaces differential diagnoses and drug interaction warnings in real time. Reduced physician documentation time by 34%.

case-studies.title: Fintrek
case-studies.subtitle: Intelligent Expense Intelligence
case-studies.description: Designed and shipped a personal finance app with an AI categorization engine and natural-language query interface. 80,000 users onboarded in the first 90 days.

case-studies.title: Cartex
case-studies.subtitle: Autonomous E-Commerce Merchandising
case-studies.description: Replaced manual product tagging and search ranking for a $40M GMV retailer with an ML pipeline that auto-tags 2M SKUs and personalizes search results per user. Conversion rate up 22%.

case-studies.title: Loopcast
case-studies.subtitle: AI Podcast Production Suite
case-studies.description: End-to-end SaaS platform for podcast creators featuring AI transcription, chapter generation, show-note writing, and clip extraction. Launched in 6 weeks.

case-studies.title: BuildIQ
case-studies.subtitle: Construction Project Intelligence
case-studies.description: Real-time project risk scoring and delay prediction for a construction management platform serving 300+ contractors. Reduced average project overrun by 18%.

case-studies.title: Synapse LMS
case-studies.subtitle: Adaptive Learning Engine
case-studies.description: Personalized learning path engine for an EdTech startup that dynamically reorders curriculum based on learner performance signals. Completion rates improved by 41%.
